artifact.name: Z-Girl v3.18 Human-Centered Commercial Foundation RC2

review.evaluator: Greene Media Studio governed production review
review.notes: RC2.2 restores the approved human-centered visual direction after owner rejection of generic vector scenes. The Human Support hero and all eight role cards now use a Greene-controlled local photorealistic sprite assembled from AI-generated relationship scenes. No remote Unsplash dependency remains on this surface. Public Demo security remains inherited from protected production main.

ai_uses.purpose: Create and integrate original photorealistic human-support scene masters for Parent, Coach, Educator, Counselor, Faith Leader, Mentor, Family, and Private Reflection
ai_uses.user_or_production_value: Restores authentic relationship-centered visuals while keeping commercial image rights and delivery under Greene-controlled storage
ai_uses.human_oversight: Owner retains final public-release approval; visual direction is reviewed on actual iPhone implementation; human supporters retain real-world authority; participant sharing stays controlled
ai_uses.provenance: AI-generated visual masters created under Greene Media Studio direction, cropped/optimized into public/visuals/human-scenes/role-sprite.jpg, and integrated in lgreene2/zgirl-hero-coach

automation.no_additional_automation_rationale: Customer entitlements, commission schedules, reseller economics, fundraising activation, and public release remain governance decisions rather than automatic actions.

evidence: Role scenes are photorealistic and relationship-specific rather than generic vector illustrations
Mobile role carousel uses complete-width cards with explicit swipe affordance
AI-assisted production created controlled commercial visual masters without reintroducing remote image-host dependence
Visuals show trusted human relationships and participant control rather than surveillance or professional substitution
Human Support hero and all role cards use one local optimized sprite
Browser-local CSS sprite rendering removes remote-host and optimizer dependency
RC remains based on current protected main
Each role scene retains descriptive aria labels from governed scenario alt text
Mobile horizontal navigation includes a visible swipe cue
Human support remains a contextual layer around the existing Hero Within experience
Public Demo security controls are inherited from current main
No participant reflection data is added to commercial marketing surfaces

exceptions: This RC does not activate public commercial release, paid checkout changes, affiliate commissions, reseller discounts, public fundraising claims, institutional customer entitlements, or new live-data access. Explicit owner approval is required before merge/release.
